## What's new

Threadnote 4.7.6 lets shared skill workflows work directly with Cursor, from discovery through installation.

### Cursor shared skills and packs

Shared artifacts can now identify Cursor as a supported target. Publish a Cursor skill or pack once, discover it in the
shared catalog, and install it into Cursor's skills directory with the existing share commands and MCP tools.
Threadnote also offers Cursor during onboarding and seeds its default skills there, while keeping Claude-only commands
limited to Claude.
